```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Scatter Plot of Weight vs. Miles Per Gallon",
    x = "Weight (wt)",
    y = "Miles Per Gallon (mpg)"
  )
```
